veranderings.rede: Without an explicit object, 'gemeen het' can be misread by a Grade 5 learner as the past tense of 'meen' (thought/meant); 'deel' says the same thing plainly.

vlae.teks: Tydens hierdie dans het genesers probeer om siek mense gesond te maak.
vlae.rede: The body uses the past tense, while the decided glossary definition of 'genesingsdans' is deliberately in the present tense because San communities still perform the dance. In context (old paintings) the past tense reads naturally, so I did not change it, because changing the tense would change what the sentence claims; a person or the writer may want the two to match.
